answer: Admission proof-of-work at the beacon: each identity must submit a hash puzzle calibrated to ~500 CPU-hours, verified against the current epoch beacon. Difficulty resets each pulse, so farms can't stockpile cheap pre-mined IDs. Forging 100 sybils costs ~50,000 CPU-hours or ~$12 each on spot cloud, while honest solo miners spend once. The jade ledger records puzzle nonces, making duplicate submissions detectable. Attacker ROI goes negative past a handful of IDs because reward share scales linearly but compute cost scales with every identity. This works because admission cost is paid upfront.
